target_population: All in-scope Japanese businesses under the stated VAT administrative regime
estimand_definition: Population-weighted recurring VAT-specific real-resource inputs divided by baseline output on the same population/accounting basis
required_design: Approved probability frame with known inclusion probabilities; VAT-task time diary/log; opportunity-cost valuation; purchased-service resource bridge; common annualized period; nonresponse weights
transport_boundary: National only if frame coverage and weights support the stated population; otherwise report frame-specific result
nonidentification_guard: Private payments, VAT remittances, descriptive burden shares, or pilot means alone cannot identify national c_VAT

target_population: Treated/complier firms in the pre-specified VAT-task-specific intervention
estimand_definition: Productive internal staff hours reassigned after treatment divided by measured internal VAT-compliance hours released by treatment
required_design: Credible randomized or quasi-random VAT-task-specific burden reduction; pre/post task measurement; productive reassignment measurement; burden-reducing first stage
transport_boundary: Local treatment/complier estimand only; never relabel as national model rho
nonidentification_guard: Cross-sectional burden-output correlation or treatment assignment without measured release/reassignment is insufficient

target_population: All resources represented in model c_VAT on the target population
estimand_definition: Population-weighted productive resources created from all released VAT-specific real resources divided by all released VAT-specific real resources
required_design: Local internal-rho evidence plus provider-side released-resource/redeployment evidence or an identified mapping; representative treatment transport
transport_boundary: National abolition rho requires transport from observed intervention and coverage of external-provider resources
nonidentification_guard: Internal staff redeployment alone is not model-compatible rho when c_VAT includes purchased adviser/software/provider resources

estimand_definition: Reduced-form response of pre-specified firm outcomes to the VAT-task-specific intervention
required_design: Same treatment validity as local_rho_internal plus fixed pre/post outcome windows
transport_boundary: Local reduced form; may combine compliance and allocation channels
nonidentification_guard: Do not add this reduced form to c_VAT times rho unless direct resource and residual allocation channels are separately decomposed

target_population: All in-scope Japanese businesses under institutional VAT abolition
estimand_definition: Output-equivalent effect of removing VAT-induced allocation distortions excluding direct compliance-resource redeployment
required_design: Separate causal design for threshold, registration, transaction-network, entry/exit or investment distortions plus explicit national transport/general-equilibrium mapping
transport_boundary: This panel may collect diagnostic outcomes but is not an a_alloc identification design
nonidentification_guard: Never infer national a_alloc from burden reduction, invoice registration, or local firm-output responses alone
